attribution_finding: Reporter heading is bibliographic material, not the Court's holding.
fidelity_finding: The supplied composite heading does not correspond to the preserved heading: source says Error to the Circuit Court for the District of New York, not APPEAL ... Eastern District.
pinpoint_finding: Printed p.270 supplies heading/procedural introduction; exclude neighboring-case conclusion at file start.
scope_and_cutoff_finding: December Term 1871 is a term label. GovInfo identifies decision April 1, 1872 and citation year 1872, contradicting the supplied decision-year presentation.
proposed_action_not_applied: Use accurate bibliographic metadata and distinguish 1871 term from 1872 decision; do not present an assembled heading as verbatim.
prior_repair_status: No repair performed in this audit
